components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Canonical compact action button using semantic primary tokens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 20px; font: 600 0.8125rem/1.25 var(--font-y2k); transition: opacity 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tokenized secondary control for dense panels.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 600 0.8125rem/1.25 var(--font-y2k); transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Default tokenized search or text field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 600 0.6875rem/1.2 var(--font-y2k); letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { background: var(--secondary); color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-y2k); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 40%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Tab
components.description: Current chat-mode tab treatment for Conversation, Roleplay, and Game.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-tab { min-height: 2.125rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; background: var(--sidebar-accent); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); font: 600 0.75rem/1.2 var(--font-y2k); transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-sidebar-tab:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sidebar-accent) 70%, transparent); } .ds-sidebar-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Marinara should feel like a lovingly built story machine: visual, intimate, a little magical, and still practical enough for power users who live in settings panels. The default visual theme is called Default (Marinara) in settings and described in the app as a Y2K / retro aesthetic with glow effects.
keyCharacteristics: Default (Marinara) theme is Y2K/retro with blush-violet core tokens and a wider decorative palette.
Semantic CSS variables are the implementation contract for app chrome, panels, inputs, sidebars, and custom themes.
Compact density is normal: text-xs, 0.6875rem uppercase labels, tracking-wider, rounded-xl, and rounded-2xl all appear in dense surfaces.
Category accents are part of the app identity: violet/purple for Agents, pink/rose for Characters, amber/orange for Lorebooks, cyan/blue for Browser and Connections, emerald/teal for Personas.
Mobile layouts are first-class play surfaces, not reduced desktop leftovers.

rules.name: The Semantic Contract Rule
rules.body: Use --background, --foreground, --card, --popover, --primary, --secondary, --muted, --accent, --destructive, --border, --input, --ring, and --sidebar-* before adding a one-off color.

rules.name: The Y2K Palette Is Effects Rule
rules.body: --y2k-*, --pastel-*, and --rgb-* exist for effects, decoration, custom theme compatibility, and data color.

rules.name: The Tracker Card Rule
rules.body: Tracker cards have their own derived token family and should stay in CSS rather than frontmatter hex tokens.

rules.name: The Micro Label Rule
rules.body: 0.6875rem uppercase labels with tracking-wider are allowed in dense panels, but not for primary actions or mobile-critical instructions.

rules.name: The Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Never put heavy blur behind long chat text, JSON editors, prompt editors, logs, or repair modals.

dos: Do use the existing semantic tokens before adding one-off colors.
Do name the default theme Default (Marinara) or Y2K Marinara in product and design guidance.
Do keep game and roleplay surfaces immersive.
Do make mobile controls touch-friendly and readable.
Do pair color with labels, icons, shape, or state text for color-blind support.
donts: Don't turn Marinara into a sterile SaaS dashboard with gray cards, dry labels, and enterprise emptiness.
Don't make it a bland SillyTavern clone that copies structure without adding identity.
Don't make it feel like a generic Discord clone.
Don't build developer-only control panels that assume technical confidence.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders, decorative gradient text, nested cards, or glassmorphism as the default layout answer.
Don't describe visual_novel as a visible fourth chat tab unless the UI exposes it again.
